hashes: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with LF line endings; sha256 = the original file, bodySha256 = the text between the BEGIN and END lines
upstream: per file, when imported: the last Psychedelia commit that touched it, and whether it had uncommitted changes on top

patches.why: init(host) draws into the canvas the app gives: no strobe canvas, no #canvasWrap lookup, no window resize listener
hosted (no strobe canvas), syncPosition reads no layout: render() no longer calls getBoundingClientRect every frame

patches.replace:
var mods = {};
    var beamSprite = null; // hosted: draws a laser beam without a stroke (setBeamSprite)
patches.why: a beam function the app may set (setBeamSprite), none by default
renderLasers draws each beam with the app's beam function when one is set (it returns true when it drew it), else strokes it as before

patches.replace:
init: init,
        setBeamSprite: function(fn) { beamSprite = typeof fn === 'function' ? fn : null; },
patches.why: setBeamSprite(fn) sets (or with no function clears) the beam function
